Analysis

Era 4 of 8

1988 to 1993: Thaw and boom

Opened by: Iran and Iraq ceasefire (598, 1987), end of the Cold War.

Output rises to 48 a year, peaking at 93 resolutions in 1993. Kuwait 1990 (660 (1990)) is the last "breach of the peace"; 678 (1990) authorises "all necessary means". Europe, mostly the former Yugoslavia, reaches 26%.

286resolutions
48per year
80%adopted unanimously
14vetoed drafts
17%under Chapter VII

Where the Council looked

Region of the situationShare
Africa19%
Middle East22%
Europe26%
Asia6%
Americas8%
Thematic0%
Institutional14%
Other6%

What rose in the texts

Subjects whose share of resolutions grew by 5 points or more on the previous era.

  • Humanitarian access and aid: 6% to 27%
  • Ceasefires: 8% to 27%
  • Elections: 8% to 14%
  • Peacekeeping: 12% to 17%

Vetoes

14 vetoed drafts. No votes by permanent members on them: USSR / Russia 1, United States 13, United Kingdom 3, France 2. 2 further drafts failed for lack of votes.
